crossRefs.note: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
Which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

translations.web: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
translations.bsb: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
translations.kjv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
translations.asv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
